# hiok_identity (Resource)

A managed identity, service principal or app registration. The client secret is only available in state right after creation.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) managed, serviceprincipal or appregistration.
- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String)
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Shown once, at creation.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tenant_id` (String)
